_note: Microsoft Purview DLP policies are Security & Compliance Center objects, deployed via New-DlpCompliancePolicy / New-DlpComplianceRule in the ExchangeOnlineManagement module (same module Security & Compliance PowerShell rides on) — not ARM/Bicep.
description: The direct mitigation this project's purview-confidential-file-external-share.kql detection watches for violations of — the detection and the policy are two halves of the same control, not separate concerns.

actions.notifyMessage: This file is labeled Confidential and cannot be shared externally. Contact your manager if this share is required for a legitimate business reason.

custom_note: BlockAccess (not just audit/alert) because sensitivity-labeled Confidential data leaving the org is exactly the scenario Purview labeling exists to prevent — the detection rule exists as a secondary control for cases where labeling was missing or misapplied, not as the primary defense.
